🎯 𝗨𝗦𝗘 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗘: A fast, open-source alternative to AutoCAD for computer-aided design and drafting, accessible across multiple platforms and the web.
📅 Created: Oct 2026 • Updated: Oct 2026

✅ Command line interface
✅ Object snaps
✅ Layers
✅ Dimensions
✅ Hatches
✅ Blocks
✅ DXF drawing support
✅ Cross-platform compatibility (macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD)
✅ WebAssembly support (runs in browser)

CADCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of AutoCAD, built entirely in Rust. It aims to provide a fast and familiar CAD experience with features like command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, and hatches, running on multiple operating systems and the web.

✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Non-linear video editing

✅ Written in pure Rust
✅ Native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux
✅ Browser support via WebAssembly
✅ Custom H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and AAC codecs written in Rust
✅ GPU compositor working in linear light
✅ Frame math on exact integer time
✅ AI agent driven actions

FilmCraft is an open-source, non-linear video editor built from scratch in pure Rust, designed as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro's workflow. It offers native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with potential for browser-based use via WebAssembly.
